assertions.name: S_N0_S_at_qeq1_eq_zero
assertions.source: S_N0 = (2q+1-q²)(q²-1)/(2q²): diagnostic — S(q=1) should equal 0 (Q_β · (q-1) zero meets E_0 1/(q-1) pole). Pass ⇒ confirms this S is the SDP-constraint scalar, NOT the ladder normalization. The categorical f-construction needs symbolic Q_A(q) and α(q), not Q_β/E_0.

assertions.name: S_tower_S_at_qeq1_eq_zero
assertions.source: S_tower = S_N0 · (1-ℏ_q²): diagnostic — S(q=1) should equal 0 (Q_β · (q-1) zero meets E_0 1/(q-1) pole). Pass ⇒ confirms this S is the SDP-constraint scalar, NOT the ladder normalization. The categorical f-construction needs symbolic Q_A(q) and α(q), not Q_β/E_0.

description: Diagnostic: demonstrates that S = Q_β/E_0 is NOT the c_k ladder normalization, because S(q=1) = 0 for both N=0 and tower E_0 variants (Q_β·(q-1) zero meets E_0 1/(q-1) pole with wrong residue). Hence the 'c_k from u_ladder Taylor of S(q)' recipe of audit 2026-06-03-qbeta-markov-trace-shape-collapse.md is degenerate when S is interpreted as Q_β/E_0. The actual ladder uses Q_β/[Q_A · cos(α_eff)] from the operator-valued N=3 witness (see qbeta_1ppq_achieved.py). No fit, no CODATA residual — purely from the closed forms.
